cause: the TLS certificate nginx serves on :8443 (/etc/ssl/patient/server.crt) has expired, so patient-fetch.service's curl fails certificate verification ('certificate has expired')
cures_ok: reissue the certificate (openssl req -x509 ...) into /etc/ssl/patient/, trust it, reload nginx, rerun patient-fetch
